pages.text: Patience, love. The fish can smell hurry. &6Marina Saltwick&r, fishing master.
Cast a line wherever there's water. &6Fishing&r gives you &6Fishing XP&r, and the higher your level, the stranger the things that bite. Some will bite back. Hit sea creatures before they hit you.
Bait helps: worms for speed. Bring me &6Tidescales&r and I'll sell you proper rods, and an otter egg once you're level ten. Here, a rod. Kestrel's across the square, pacing. He's always pacing.
